The blinking caret marks the place where the live transcript is still being written while the microphone is open. It encodes a machine state (transcribing) and is switched off by the prefers-reduced-motion block in globals.css.
A regular expression that strips a site-name suffix from a web page title. The dash characters are the input the pattern has to match in a fetched page, not copy shown to a reader.
